To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
curriculum learning can help improve the quality of the generated sequences and that it is a promising direction of research.

(1) Scheduled Sampling, a curriculum learning technique, improves the quality of the generated sequences in sequence prediction tasks; (2) This improvement is particularly important for the last tokens in the sequences; and (3) The technique was successfully used in our winning entry of the MSCOCO Image Captioning Challenge 2015, where it improved the performance of the system by a large margin.

improving the performance of recurrent neural networks for sequence prediction.
improving the performance of sequence prediction tasks by using a curriculum learning strategy that gradually replaces the true previous tokens with generated tokens.
